integrity: The proof is an exact four-point calculation: the diagonal pair-sum dominates, a balancing bound reduces the problem to a one-parameter sequence that is proved strictly increasing, and balanced terminal gap patterns attain equality. A standalone exhaustive checker independently verifies all four-subsets for n from 4 through 60 as a finite sanity check.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats the Euclidean chord metric on vertices of a regular n-gon for n at least 4. It does not cover intrinsic cycle-graph distance, arbitrary cyclic point sets, or perturbed polygons.
title: Exact four-point hyperbolicity of regular polygon chord metrics
